$comment: What a complete in-person V1 needs from Designer that the slices so far do not contain. Nothing listed here exists as an asset. An entry names the fact it would be drawn from; where the audience views at the base commit do not carry that fact, `needs` says so. docs/design/asset-inventory.md is generated from this file and from the asset manifest.

items.title: Final Zone vignette
items.needs: The showdown phase in the audience views. Protocol 1 has no such phase; the panel must not be drawn before it. It will need a color family of its own in the tokens.

items.title: Layer exports of Room B, the Command Room, the Hospital and the Jail
items.needs: Frontend's renderer evaluation. The four are exported whole; their layers are groups in the sources and lift the way Room A's do.
items.until: The whole picture of each room.

items.title: Role card back and the hand
items.needs: A place in the markup for a card that is dealt face down, the same whatever its face. Drawn in the approved exploration. Today the closed private dock stands for it.

items.title: Move
items.needs: The server's own list of destinations for the seat. Protocol 1 carries none.
items.until: Frontend's functional placement in its connected prototype.

items.title: Role actions (protect, rescue, disable, supply, scan)
items.needs: Per-action availability and the server's own target lists. Protocol 1 carries none.

items.title: Standard Hack request and conversation
items.needs: The Hack phase and the seat's own Hack availability. Two separate states; no ordinary private chat.

items.title: Code entry
items.needs: The seat's own Code attempt availability. Private.

items.title: Vote and release ballot
items.needs: The voting phases, the eligible sets and what a ballot discloses, none of which protocol 1 carries.

items.title: Revealed faction marker
items.needs: A public revealed-faction fact per seat at its permitted reveal step. This is the one place a faction color may appear publicly, and it still needs its word.
items.until: Not drawn. No faction color on any public surface.

items.title: Vote tally
items.needs: A public tally fact.

items.title: Match result cover
items.needs: A terminal public result, and the permitted end-of-match reveals.

items.title: Choosing a character and typing a name
items.needs: The lobby step and the public identity record of a seat (DSN-REQ-6). Drawn and playable in the approved exploration; no markup exists to style. The nine pictures are produced.

items.title: Lobby and seating
items.needs: The lobby flow and its contracts. Not part of protocol 1.

items.title: Host session controls
items.needs: The host's approved controls. Being host grants no extra visibility.

items.title: Masthead wordmark
items.needs: Original vector lettering. Today the wordmark is live text in the system heading stack.

items.title: Lettering typeface
items.needs: The game owner's choice of a typeface and its license (DSN-D05). No font file is included.
items.until: The system condensed stack in the tokens.

items.title: Table display: token lands
items.needs: A sound source with rights, and a listening review. Public facts only; phones stay silent for secret actions.

items.title: Table display: page turn at a new round
items.needs: As above.

items.title: Printable token, marker and board sheet
items.needs: A decision on the physical board option and its paper sizes. The sources are vector and print as they are.
items.until: The earlier A3 prototype under reference/.

items.title: GLB geometry for the Three.js evaluation
items.needs: Frontend's renderer evaluation and its measured budgets. The Room A layers carry a stack order and proposed depths meanwhile.
